alt: Figure 3 from Age-associated clonal B cells drive B cell lymphoma in mice
caption: Figure 3. Longitudinal analysis and transplantation experiments reveal ACBCs as a cancerous B cell population that leads to animal fatalities, and co- culture experiments point to their origin.
